description: Reverse-ETL / audience activation: upload an upstream DataFrame into a Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Custom Audience via the native /{custom_audience_id}/users endpoint. Identifiers (email/phone) are normalized and SHA-256 hashed before upload — never sent to Meta in plaintext. Supports 'add' (activation) and 'remove' (suppression).

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row contributes one or more hashed identifiers (email/phone) to the target Custom Audience.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (custom_audience_id / rows_submitted / rows_skipped_no_identifier / operation / schema / api_requests).

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

custom_audience_id.label: Custom Audience ID
custom_audience_id.description: Target Meta Custom Audience ID. Must already exist.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> identifier type ('email' or 'phone'). Values are SHA-256 hashed before upload.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

name: Meta Custom Audience Upsert
